title: Media generation joins Chat and Responses
summary:
Media models found their way into Chat, image-to-3D gained a Gaussian-splat option, and GIMP and the SDK got new ways to make things.

Image, video, audio, and 3D models with supported text-input routes can now generate from prompts sent to `/v1/chat/completions` or `/v1/responses`. Supported image and video models also accept image parts for edits or video start frames. Both paths return public media links; image generation and edits received cache and request-handling fixes.

Community-contributed `nvidia/asset-harvester` adds reference-image-to-3D generation, returning a PLY Gaussian splat rather than a GLB. It requires Paid Pollen and its canonical model ID. The shared 3D client now retries temporary server errors while checking a generation job, and the docs reflect the model's input and output.

A community GIMP 3 plug-in brings generation and non-destructive layer editing into the editor. The SDK gained typed `embeddings()` methods for text and multimodal inputs. Hosted agents now represent completed server-run tools as paired function items for continuation, while MCP returns existing public media URLs instead of copying files. CLI harness defaults were refreshed, and the app catalog gained PolliArena for blind image-model comparisons.

highlights.title: Media generation in conversations
highlights.text: Send a text prompt to a supported image, video, audio, or 3D model through `/v1/chat/completions` or `/v1/responses` and get a public media link back. Generation settings still belong on the native media endpoints. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Image inputs for media models
highlights.text: Send an image URL or data URI alongside a prompt to a supported image or video model in Chat or Responses. Use it as a source for an image edit or as a video start frame. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Image-to-3D Gaussian splats
highlights.text: Give `nvidia/asset-harvester` a reference image and get a Gaussian-splat PLY file through the 3D API. Use the canonical model ID; this model requires Paid Pollen. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nvidia/asset-harvester).

highlights.title: Pollinations inside GIMP 3
highlights.text: A community GIMP 3 plug-in can generate an image or edit the active layer, placing the result in a new layer so the source stays put. It connects through browser-based account approval and offers the image models available to your account.

highlights.title: Embeddings in the SDK
highlights.text: Use `embeddings()` in `@pollinations/sdk` for single text, batches, or supported text, image, audio, and video content parts. Options include model, dimensions, encoding, and provider-specific input types. [View the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).
